hadiths.arabicText: قَالَ مَالِك : قَالَ يَحْيَى بْنُ سَعِيدٍ : قَالَ سَعِيدُ بْنُ الْمُسَيَّبِ : " فَمَا انْسَلَخَ ذُو الْحِجَّةِ ، حَتَّى قُتِلَ عُمَرُ رَحِمَهُ اللَّهُ " . قَالَ يَحْيَى : سَمِعْتُ مَالِكًا ، يَقُولُ : قَوْلُهُ الشَّيْخُ وَالشَّيْخَةُ ، يَعْنِي الثَّيِّبَ وَالثَّيِّبَةَ ، فَارْجُمُوهُمَا الْبَتَّةَ *

hadiths.english_translation: Narrated from Malik that it reached him: That Uthman ibn Affan was brought a woman who had given birth after six months, so he ordered that she be stoned. Ali ibn Abi Talib said to him: 'That is not upon her. Indeed Allah the Blessed and Exalted says in His Book: And his bearing and weaning is thirty months (Quran 46:15), and He said: Mothers shall suckle their children for two complete years for whoever wishes to complete the suckling (Quran 2:233). So the pregnancy can be six months, so there is no stoning upon her.' Then Uthman ibn Affan sent after her, but found that she had already been stoned.

hadiths.arabicText: وَحَدَّثَنِي مَالِك أَنَّهُ بَلَغَهُ ، أَنَّ عُثْمَانَ بْنَ عَفَّانَ أُتِيَ بِامْرَأَةٍ قَدْ وَلَدَتْ فِي سِتَّةِ أَشْهُرٍ ، فَأَمَرَ بِهَا أَنْ تُرْجَمَ ، فَقَالَ لَهُ عَلِيُّ بْنُ أَبِي طَالِبٍ : " لَيْسَ ذَلِكَ عَلَيْهَا ، إِنَّ اللَّهَ تَبَارَكَ وَتَعَالَى ، يَقُولُ فِي كِتَابِهِ : وَحَمْلُهُ وَفِصَالُهُ ثَلاثُونَ شَهْرًا سورة الأحقاف آية 15 ، وَقَالَ : وَالْوَالِدَاتُ يُرْضِعْنَ أَوْلادَهُنَّ حَوْلَيْنِ كَامِلَيْنِ لِمَنْ أَرَادَ أَنْ يُتِمَّ الرَّضَاعَةَ سورة البقرة آية 233 ، فَالْحَمْلُ يَكُونُ سِتَّةَ أَشْهُرٍ ، فَلَا رَجْمَ عَلَيْهَا " . فَبَعَثَ عُثْمَانُ بْنُ عَفَّانَ فِي أَثَرِهَا ، فَوَجَدَهَا قَدْ رُجِمَتْ *

hadiths.english_translation: Narrated from Malik, from Zayd ibn Aslam: That a man confessed to adultery upon himself during the time of the Messenger of Allah ﷺ, so the Messenger of Allah ﷺ called for a whip for him. He was brought a broken whip, so he said: 'More than this.' Then he was brought a new whip whose thorns had not been cut, so he said: 'Less than this.' Then he was brought a whip that had been used and softened, so the Messenger of Allah ﷺ ordered with it and he was flogged. Then he said: 'O people, it is time for you to refrain from transgressing the limits of Allah. Whoever commits any of these filthy acts, let him conceal himself with the concealment of Allah. For indeed, whoever exposes to us his matter, we will establish upon him the Book of Allah.'

hadiths.arabicText: حَدَّثَنِي مَالِك ، عَنْ زَيْدِ بْنِ أَسْلَمَ ، أَنّ رَجُلًا اعْتَرَفَ عَلَى نَفْسِهِ بِالزِّنَا عَلَى عَهْدِ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ ، فَدَعَا لَهُ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ بِسَوْطٍ ، فَأُتِيَ بِسَوْطٍ مَكْسُورٍ ، فَقَالَ : " فَوْقَ هَذَا " . فَأُتِيَ بِسَوْطٍ جَدِيدٍ لَمْ تُقْطَعْ ثَمَرَتُهُ ، فَقَالَ : " دُونَ هَذَا " . فَأُتِيَ بِسَوْطٍ قَدْ رُكِبَ بِهِ وَلَانَ ، فَأَمَرَ بِهِ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ ، فَجُلِدَ ، ثُمَّ قَالَ : " أَيُّهَا النَّاسُ ، قَدْ آنَ لَكُمْ أَنْ تَنْتَهُوا عَنْ حُدُودِ اللَّهِ ، مَنْ أَصَابَ مِنْ هَذِهِ الْقَاذُورَاتِ شَيْئًا ، فَلْيَسْتَتِرْ بِسِتْرِ اللَّهِ ، فَإِنَّهُ مَنْ يُبْدِي لَنَا صَفْحَتَهُ ، نُقِمْ عَلَيْهِ كِتَابَ اللَّهِ " *

hadiths.english_translation: Narrated from Malik, from Nafi', that Safiyyah bint Abi Ubayd informed him: That Abu Bakr al-Siddiq was brought a man who had sexual relations with a virgin slave girl and impregnated her, then confessed to adultery upon himself, and he had not been married. So Abu Bakr ordered that he be flogged with the prescribed punishment, then exiled to Fadak. Malik said regarding the one who confesses to adultery upon himself then retracts from that and says: 'I did not do it, and that was only from me in such and such manner' for something he mentions: That is accepted from him, and the punishment is not established upon him. That is because the punishment which is for Allah is not taken except by one of two ways: either by just testimony that establishes it upon its doer, or by confession which he maintains until the punishment is established upon him. So if he maintains his confession, the punishment is established upon him. Malik said: What I have found the people of knowledge upon is that there is no exile upon slaves when they commit adultery.

hadiths.arabicText: حَدَّثَنِي مَالِك ، عَنْ نَافِعٍ ، أَنَّ صَفِيَّةَ بِنْتَ أَبِي عُبَيْدٍ أَخْبَرَتْهُ ، أَنَّ أَبَا بَكْرٍ الصِّدِّيقَ " أُتِيَ بِرَجُلٍ قَدْ وَقَعَ عَلَى جَارِيَةٍ بِكْرٍ فَأَحْبَلَهَا ، ثُمَّ اعْتَرَفَ عَلَى نَفْسِهِ بِالزِّنَا وَلَمْ يَكُنْ أَحْصَنَ ، " فَأَمَرَ بِهِ أَبُو بَكْرٍ فَجُلِدَ الْحَدَّ ، ثُمَّ نُفِيَ إِلَى فَدَكَ " . قَالَ مَالِك ، فِي الَّذِي يَعْتَرِفُ عَلَى نَفْسِهِ بِالزِّنَا ، ثُمَّ يَرْجِعُ عَنْ ذَلِكَ ، وَيَقُولُ : لَمْ أَفْعَلْ ، وَإِنَّمَا كَانَ ذَلِكَ مِنِّي عَلَى وَجْهِ كَذَا وَكَذَا لِشَيْءٍ يَذْكُرُهُ : إِنَّ ذَلِكَ يُقْبَلُ مِنْهُ ، وَلَا يُقَامُ عَلَيْهِ الْحَدُّ ، وَذَلِكَ أَنَّ الْحَدَّ الَّذِي هُوَ لِلَّهِ لَا يُؤْخَذُ إِلَّا بِأَحَدِ وَجْهَيْنِ ، إِمَّا بِبَيِّنَةٍ عَادِلَةٍ تُثْبِتُ عَلَى صَاحِبِهَا ، وَإِمَّا بِاعْتِرَافٍ يُقِيمُ عَلَيْهِ حَتَّى يُقَامَ عَلَيْهِ الْحَدُّ ، فَإِنْ أَقَامَ عَلَى اعْتِرَافِهِ أُقِيمَ عَلَيْهِ الْحَدُّ . قَالَ مَالِك : الَّذِي أَدْرَكْتُ عَلَيْهِ أَهْلَ الْعِلْمِ ، أَنَّهُ لَا نَفْيَ عَلَى الْعَبِيدِ إِذَا زَنَوْا *

hadiths.arabicText: بَابُ جَامِعِ مَا جَاءَ فِي حَدِّ الزِّنَا

hadiths.english_translation: Narrated from Malik, from Ibn Shihab, from Ubaydullah ibn Abdullah ibn Utbah ibn Mas'ud, from Abu Hurayrah and Zayd ibn Khalid al-Juhani: That the Messenger of Allah ﷺ was asked about the slave girl when she commits adultery and is not married. He said: 'If she commits adultery, flog her. Then if she commits adultery, flog her. Then if she commits adultery, flog her. Then sell her even if for a rope.' Ibn Shihab said: I do not know whether it was after the third or the fourth time. Yahya said: I heard Malik saying: 'The dafir is the rope.' [Second narration:] Narrated from Malik, from Nafi': That a slave who was in charge of the slaves of the khums (one-fifth), and he forced himself upon a slave girl from those slaves and had relations with her. So Umar ibn al-Khattab flogged him and exiled him, and he did not flog the slave girl because he had forced her.

hadiths.arabicText: حَدَّثَنِي مَالِك ، عَنْ ابْنِ شِهَابٍ ، عَنْ عُبَيْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ عُتْبَةَ بْنِ مَسْعُودٍ ، عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ ، وَزَيْدِ بْنِ خَالِدٍ الْجُهَنِيِّ ، أَنّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ سُئِلَ عَنِ الْأَمَةِ إِذَا زَنَتْ وَلَمْ تُحْصِنْ ؟ فَقَالَ : " إِنْ زَنَتْ فَاجْلِدُوهَا ، ثُمَّ إِنْ زَنَتْ فَاجْلِدُوهَا ، ثُمَّ إِنْ زَنَتْ فَاجْلِدُوهَا ، ثُمَّ بِيعُوهَا وَلَوْ بِضَفِيرٍ " . قَالَ ابْنُ شِهَابٍ : لَا أَدْرِي أَبَعْدَ الثَّالِثَةِ أَوِ الرَّابِعَةِ ؟ قَالَ يَحْيَى : سَمِعْتُ مَالِكًا ، يَقُولُ : وَالضَّفِيرُ : الْحَبْلُ * حَدَّثَنِي مَالِك ، عَنْ نَافِعٍ ، أَنّ عَبْدًا كَانَ يَقُومُ عَلَى رَقِيقِ الْخُمُسِ ، وَأَنَّهُ اسْتَكْرَهَ جَارِيَةً مِنْ ذَلِكَ الرَّقِيقِ ، فَوَقَعَ بِهَا ، " فَجَلَدَهُ عُمَرُ بْنُ الْخَطَّابِ وَنَفَاهُ ، وَلَمْ يَجْلِدِ الْوَلِيدَةَ لِأَنَّهُ اسْتَكْرَهَهَا " *

hadiths.arabicText: حَدَّثَنِي مَالِك ، عَنْ يَحْيَى بْنِ سَعِيدٍ ، أَنَّ سُلَيْمَانَ بْنَ يَسَارٍ أَخْبَرَهُ ، أَنَّ عَبْدَ اللَّهِ بْنَ عَيَّاشِ بْنِ أَبِي رَبِيعَةَ الْمَخْزُومِيَّ ، قَالَ : " أَمَرَنِي عُمَرُ بْنُ الْخَطَّابِ فِي فِتْيَةٍ مِنْ قُرَيْشٍ ، فَجَلَدْنَا وَلَائِدَ مِنْ وَلَائِدِ الْإِمَارَةِ خَمْسِينَ خَمْسِينَ فِي الزِّنَا " * '

hadiths.english_translation: Chapter: What has come regarding the woman who is raped
Topics: Chapter Heading

hadiths.english_translation: Malik said: The practice among us regarding a woman who is found pregnant and has no husband, and she says: 'I was forced,' or she says: 'I was married,' is that this is not accepted from her, and the punishment is established upon her, unless she has evidence for what she claimed of marriage, or that she was forced, or she came bleeding if she was a virgin, or she called for help until she was reached while in that state, or something similar to this from matters that reach the point of exposing herself to disgrace. He said: If she does not bring anything of this, the punishment is established upon her, and what she claimed of that is not accepted from her. Malik said: The raped woman does not marry until she performs istibra' (waiting period to ensure no pregnancy) for herself with three menstrual cycles. He said: If she has doubt about her menstruation, then she does not marry until she performs istibra' from that doubt.

potential_issues.issue: This is entirely Malik's personal legal opinion and juristic reasoning, not a hadith narration
potential_issues.impact: This represents Maliki fiqh positions, not transmitted prophetic guidance. It has value as scholarly opinion but is not hadith.

hadiths.arabicText: قَالَ مَالِك : الْأَمْرُ عِنْدَنَا فِي الْمَرْأَةِ تُوجَدُ حَامِلًا وَلَا زَوْجَ لَهَا ، فَتَقُولُ : قَدِ اسْتُكْرِهْتُ ، أَوْ تَقُولُ : تَزَوَّجْتُ ، إِنَّ ذَلِكَ لَا يُقْبَلُ مِنْهَا ، وَإِنَّهَا يُقَامُ عَلَيْهَا الْحَدُّ ، إِلَّا أَنْ يَكُونَ لَهَا عَلَى مَا ادَّعَتْ مِنَ النِّكَاحِ بَيِّنَةٌ ، أَوْ عَلَى أَنَّهَا اسْتُكْرِهَتْ ، أَوْ جَاءَتْ تَدْمَى إِنْ كَانَتْ بِكْرًا ، أَوِ اسْتَغَاثَتْ حَتَّى أُتِيَتْ وَهِيَ عَلَى ذَلِكَ الْحَالِ ، أَوْ مَا أَشْبَهَ هَذَا مِنَ الْأَمْرِ الَّذِي تَبْلُغُ فِيهِ فَضِيحَةَ نَفْسِهَا ، قَالَ : فَإِنْ لَمْ تَأْتِ بِشَيْءٍ مِنْ هَذَا ، أُقِيمَ عَلَيْهَا الْحَدُّ ، وَلَمْ يُقْبَلْ مِنْهَا مَا ادَّعَتْ مِنْ ذَلِكَ . قَالَ مَالِك : وَالْمُغْتَصَبَةُ لَا تَنْكِحُ حَتَّى تَسْتَبْرِئَ نَفْسَهَا بِثَلَاثِ حِيَضٍ ، قَالَ : فَإِنِ ارْتَابَتْ مِنْ حَيْضَتِهَا ، فَلَا تَنْكِحُ حَتَّى تَسْتَبْرِئَ نَفْسَهَا مِنْ تِلْكَ الرِّيبَةِ .

hadiths.english_translation: Narrated from Malik, from Abu al-Zinad: That he said: 'Umar ibn Abdul Aziz flogged a slave for slander eighty times.' Abu al-Zinad said: So I asked Abdullah ibn Amir ibn Rabi'ah about that, and he said: 'I witnessed Umar ibn al-Khattab, and Uthman ibn Affan, and the caliphs successively, and I never saw anyone flog a slave for slander more than forty.'

hadiths.arabicText: حَدَّثَنِي مَالِك ، عَنْ أَبِي الزِّنَادِ ، أَنَّهُ قَالَ : " جَلَدَ عُمَرُ بْنُ عَبْدِ الْعَزِيزِ عَبْدًا فِي فِرْيَةٍ ثَمَانِينَ " * قَالَ أَبُو الزِّنَادِ : فَسَأَلْتُ عَبْدَ اللَّهِ بْنَ عَامِرِ بْنِ رَبِيعَةَ عَنْ ذَلِكَ ، فَقَالَ : " أَدْرَكْتُ عُمَرَ بْنَ الْخَطَّابِ ، وَعُثْمَانَ بْنَ عَفَّانَ وَالْخُلَفَاءَ هَلُمَّ جَرًّا ، فَمَا رَأَيْتُ أَحَدًا جَلَدَ عَبْدًا فِي فِرْيَةٍ أَكْثَرَ مِنْ أَرْبَعِينَ " *

hadiths.english_translation: Narrated from Malik, from Zurayq ibn Hakim al-Ayli: That a man called Misbah asked his son for help, and it seemed he was taking too long. When he came to him, he said to him: 'O adulterer.' Zurayq said: So he sought my judgment against him. When I wanted to flog him, his son said: 'By Allah, if you flog him, I will certainly confess adultery upon myself.' When he said that, the matter became problematic for me, so I wrote about it to Umar ibn Abdul Aziz, who was the governor at that time, mentioning that to him. Umar wrote to me: 'Execute his pardon.' Zurayq said: And I wrote to Umar ibn Abdul Aziz also: 'What do you see about a man who was slandered, or his parents while they had died, or one of them?' So Umar wrote to me: 'If he pardons, execute his pardon regarding himself. And if slander was made against his parents and they had died or one of them, then take for him according to the Book of Allah, unless he wants concealment.' Yahya said: I heard Malik saying: 'That is when the man who was slandered fears that if that is exposed from him, evidence might be established against him. So when it is as I described and he pardons, his pardon is valid.'

hadiths.arabicText: حَدَّثَنِي مَالِك ، عَنْ زُرَيْقِ بْنِ حَكِيمٍ الْأَيْلِيِّ ، أَنَّ رَجُلًا ، يُقَالُ لَهُ مِصْبَاحٌ ، اسْتَعَانَ ابْنًا لَهُ ، فَكَأَنَّهُ اسْتَبْطَأَهُ ، فَلَمَّا جَاءَهُ ، قَالَ لَهُ : يَا زَانٍ . قَالَ زُرَيْقٌ : فَاسْتَعْدَانِي عَلَيْهِ ، فَلَمَّا أَرَدْتُ أَنْ أَجْلِدَهُ ، قَالَ ابْنُهُ : وَاللَّهِ لَئِنْ جَلَدْتَهُ ، لَأَبُوءَنَّ عَلَى نَفْسِي بِالزِّنَا . فَلَمَّا قَالَ ذَلِكَ ، أَشْكَلَ عَلَيَّ أَمْرُهُ ، فَكَتَبْتُ فِيهِ إِلَى عُمَرَ بْنِ عَبْدِ الْعَزِيزِ وَهُوَ الْوَالِي يَوْمَئِذٍ أَذْكُرُ لَهُ ذَلِكَ ، فَكَتَبَ إِلَيَّ عُمَرُ : أَنْ " أَجِزْ عَفْوَهُ " . قَالَ زُرَيْقٌ : وَكَتَبْتُ إِلَى عُمَرَ بْنِ عَبْدِ الْعَزِيزِ أَيْضًا : أَرَأَيْتَ رَجُلًا افْتُرِيَ عَلَيْهِ أَوْ عَلَى أَبَوَيْهِ وَقَدْ هَلَكَا أَوْ أَحَدُهُمَا ؟ قَالَ : فَكَتَبَ إِلَيَّ عُمَرُ : " إِنْ عَفَا فَأَجِزْ عَفْوَهُ فِي نَفْسِهِ ، وَإِنِ افْتُرِيَ عَلَى أَبَوَيْهِ وَقَدْ هَلَكَا أَوْ أَحَدُهُمَا فَخُذْ لَهُ بِكِتَابِ اللَّهِ إِلَّا أَنْ يُرِيدَ سِتْرًا " . قَالَ يَحْيَى : سَمِعْتُ مَالِكًا ، يَقُولُ : وَذَلِكَ أَنْ يَكُونَ الرَّجُلُ الْمُفْتَرَى عَلَيْهِ يَخَافُ إِنْ كُشِفَ ذَلِكَ مِنْهُ أَنْ تَقُومَ عَلَيْهِ بَيِّنَةٌ ، فَإِذَا كَانَ عَلَى مَا وَصَفْتُ فَعَفَا ، جَازَ عَفْوُهُ * 

hadiths.english_translation: Narrated from Malik, from Hisham ibn Urwah, from his father: That he said regarding a man who slandered a group of people: 'There is only one punishment upon him.' Malik said: 'Even if they were separated, there is only one punishment upon him.' [Second narration:] Narrated from Malik, from Abu al-Rijal Muhammad ibn Abd al-Rahman ibn Harithah ibn al-Nu'man al-Ansari, then from Bani al-Najjar, from his mother Amrah bint Abd al-Rahman: That two men insulted each other during the time of Umar ibn al-Khattab, and one of them said to the other: 'By Allah, my father is not an adulterer nor is my mother an adulteress.' Umar ibn al-Khattab sought consultation about that. Some said: 'He praised his father and mother.' Others said: 'There was praise for his father and mother other than this. We see that you should flog him with the punishment.' So Umar flogged him the punishment of eighty. Malik said: 'There is no punishment with us except for denial of lineage, or slander, or indirect accusation that is seen that the one who said it only intended denial or slander. So upon the one who said that is the full punishment.' Malik said: 'The practice among us is that when a man denies another man from his father, then upon him is the punishment, even if the mother of the one who was denied was a slave woman, then upon him is the punishment.'

Umar's Ruling to Punish for Indirect Slander
Legal Principle of One Punishment for Multiple Victims in Same Statement
hadiths.arabicText: حَدَّثَنِي مَالِك ، عَنْ هِشَامِ بْنِ عُرْوَةَ ، عَنْ أَبِيهِ ، أَنَّهُ قَالَ فِي رَجُلٍ قَذَفَ قَوْمًا جَمَاعَةً : " أَنَّهُ لَيْسَ عَلَيْهِ إِلَّا حَدٌّ وَاحِدٌ " . قَالَ مَالِك : وَإِنْ تَفَرَّقُوا ، فَلَيْسَ عَلَيْهِ إِلَّا حَدٌّ وَاحِدٌ * حَدَّثَنِي مَالِك ، عَنْ أَبِي الرِّجَالِ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ بْنِ حَارِثَةَ بْنِ النُّعْمَانِ الْأَنْصَارِيِّ ثُمَّ مِنْ بَنِي النَّجَّارِ ، عَنْ أُمِّهِ عَمْرَةَ بِنْتِ عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ ، أَنَّ رَجُلَيْنِ اسْتَبَّا فِي زَمَانِ عُمَرَ بْنِ الْخَطَّابِ ، فَقَالَ أَحَدُهُمَا لِلْآخَرِ : وَاللَّهِ مَا أَبِي بِزَانٍ وَلَا أُمِّي بِزَانِيَةٍ . فَاسْتَشَارَ فِي ذَلِكَ عُمَرُ بْنُ الْخَطَّابِ ، فَقَالَ قَائِلٌ : مَدَحَ أَبَاهُ وَأُمَّهُ ، وَقَالَ آخَرُونَ : قَدْ كَانَ لِأَبِيهِ وَأُمِّهِ مَدْحٌ غَيْرُ هَذَا ، نَرَى أَنْ تَجْلِدَهُ الْحَدَّ ، " فَجَلَدَهُ عُمَرُ الْحَدَّ ثَمَانِينَ " . قَالَ مَالِك : لَا حَدَّ عِنْدَنَا إِلَّا فِي نَفْيٍ أَوْ قَذْفٍ أَوْ تَعْرِيضٍ ، يُرَى أَنَّ قَائِلَهُ إِنَّمَا أَرَادَ بِذَلِكَ نَفْيًا أَوْ قَذْفًا ، فَعَلَى مَنْ قَالَ ذَلِكَ الْحَدُّ تَامًّا . قَالَ مَالِك : الْأَمْرُ عِنْدَنَا ، أَنَّهُ إِذَا نَفَى رَجُلٌ رَجُلًا مِنْ أَبِيهِ ، فَإِنَّ عَلَيْهِ الْحَدَّ ، وَإِنْ كَانَتْ أُمُّ الَّذِي نُفِيَ مَمْلُوكَةً ، فَإِنَّ عَلَيْهِ الْحَدَّ * 
